source_review.notes: Checked all ten final NASA and Acquisition.gov references on 2026-08-31; every URL returned HTTP 200. Reviewed NASA software acceptance criteria, Product Transition, Product Validation, handbook acceptance/V&V content, Technical Assessment, NPR 7123.1B, and current FAC 2026-01 FAR material on quality, acceptance, nonconformance, and warranties. FAR examples are expressly limited to their governing context rather than generalized as universal law.

evidence: Reviewed tender x, acceptance basis B_a, criteria C, predicate p_i, criticality k_i, evidence E_i, disposition D_i, results r_i, and authority alpha.
Reviewed accept/conditional/reject piecewise decision rule and its authority constraints.
Reviewed quantitative rule components T(Y), threshold theta, direction, rounding, population, sample, and uncertainty.
Confirmed waiver notation modifies obligation/disposition rather than rewriting a failed result.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation is internally consistent and models a governed decision, not legal advice or an automated authority substitute.

evidence: Executed acceptance-decision-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-078/report.json.
Confirmed initial counts of six passed, one failed, and one conditional criterion across eight criteria.
Confirmed the failed mandatory safety_case forces reject despite six passes.
Confirmed curing safety_case yields seven passes and one conditional item, requiring conditional-acceptance authority.
Recomputed Exercise 2 nearest-rank position ceil(0.99*1000)=990 and confirmed 392 ms passes the 400 ms rule.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The arithmetic applies only to the declared synthetic rule and literal percentile procedure; it does not determine evidence adequacy, safety, legality, uncertainty, or real acceptance.

evidence: Confirmed many low-criticality passes cannot imply acceptance when one blocking predicate fails.
Confirmed not-evaluated evidence cannot logically collapse into pass.
Confirmed a waiver changes an obligation/disposition but does not transform failed empirical evidence into passed evidence.
Confirmed evidence for one build does not transfer to a different tender without an equivalence/delta argument.
Confirmed delivery, custody, installation, technical approval, payment, and formal acceptance can be distinct governed events.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter uses conditional decision logic and counterexamples without claiming a universal acceptance calculus.

evidence: Challenged vague criteria, post-result threshold changes, measurement planes, percentiles, errors, sample rules, uncertainty, rounding, and aggregate compensation.
Challenged wrong-build evidence, prototypes versus production units, source/destination inspection, sampled lots, destructive tests, and environment failures.
Challenged missing licenses, rights, SBOM, manuals, training, spares, support, installation, data migration, backup/restore, and readiness.
Challenged undocumented waivers, unknown impacts, conditional acceptance without cure/remedy, urgent nonconformance, witnessing versus authority, and customer bias.
Challenged latent defects, vulnerabilities, warranties, post-acceptance obligations, service averages, intermittent failures, and partial/incremental transitions.
Reviewed all ten examples and five complete answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, limitations, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real acceptance requires applicable engineering, customer/user, contract/procurement, safety, security, quality, operations, support, configuration, finance, legal, and authorized decision expertise.

evidence: Confirmed criteria precede observation and trace to a controlled acceptance basis.
Confirmed quantitative and qualitative criteria remain objectively decision-ready and authority-owned.
Confirmed evidence and tender share configuration identity and missing evidence never passes.
Confirmed mandatory failures remain noncompensatory and criteria changes require change control.
Confirmed conditional acceptance includes scope, owner, deadline, controls, residual risk, remedy, retest, and nonclosure consequence.
Confirmed decision records state transfer effects and preserve warranty, latent-defect, correction, monitoring, and reacceptance obligations as applicable.
invariant_checking.notes: No demo, majority vote, certification, physical delivery, waiver, schedule pressure, or signature without authority is treated as sufficient alone.

proof_review.notes: No formal proof or theorem requires proof review; the module presents a bounded decision rule and arithmetic.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled synthetic_decision_rules_only.
Fixture limitations disclaim criterion adequacy, evidence truth, legal authority, safety, conditions, remedies, and real decisions.
Examples and exercises are teaching cases, not contractual determinations, certifications, field results, or legal guidance.
Official sources are attributed without claiming external review or endorsement.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic logic, source-backed guidance, internal review, technical recommendation, and authorized acceptance remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked acceptance, verification, validation, qualification, certification, readiness, delivery and payment distinctions; acceptance basis; tender; criteria; criticality; evidence; configuration; authority; rejection; waivers; conditions; transition; and post-acceptance obligations.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked atomic criteria, quantitative/qualitative decision rules, entry/test/acceptance separation, provenance, witnessing, anomalies, retest, conditional acceptance, data packages, rights/licenses, readiness, transfer records, remedies, warranties, and reacceptance.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from authority and basis through criterion design, evidence execution, disposition, transfer, and lifecycle controls. Ten examples and five complete solutions cover performance, configuration, custody, services, conditions, software artifacts, sampling, anomalous runs, urgent deviations, and latent vulnerabilities.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA/GSA official, customer, contracting officer, legal counsel, regulator, safety/security authority, quality organization, supplier, operator, support owner, configuration authority, auditor, certification body, or other external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
